items.reason: Added the checkpoint a stopped run leaves behind: scripts/agent-checkpoint.mjs + a pure core, `.agent/checkpoints/<session>.json` (tracked, so it travels out of a worktree), a standing instruction in AGENTS.md (canonical guidance, loaded every session), `npm run checkpoint:check` inside check:ci, and test-unit/agent-checkpoint.test.mjs asserting both the rules and the wiring — the two involuntary layers (.husky/pre-commit and the .claude/settings.json hooks) are written verbatim in .agent/README.md but could not be applied here because this lane refuses to write either file.

needs network: pinning is one command (`npm run actions:pin`) that resolves each tag through api.github.com and writes STRICT = true plus the ratchet back into scripts/actions-pin.mjs in the same pass — with no network I can neither resolve a tag to a SHA nor invent one without breaking the workflow, and the same holds for the node:24-alpine digest in the Dockerfile.

needs a test runner: a mutation score is a measured number, and both halves of the artefact this asks for (the kill rate on plans.ts / usage.ts / durable-limit.ts / the chokepoint, and the threshold it would hold in check:ci) require running node --test against generated mutants, which this session cannot do; committing an unexecuted mutation engine plus an invented baseline would be the ratchet-at-zero failure ADR-0007 already records.

needs a type checker: the count under noUncheckedIndexedAccess / exactOptionalPropertyTypes is unknown and unfixable without running tsc, and flipping them blind would take `npm run typecheck` red for everyone; left tsconfig.strict.json + `npm run typecheck:strict` so the measurement is one command, and recorded that allowJs is load-bearing on src/lib/demo/prng.mjs (imported by seven TS modules and executed directly by the node:test suites) rather than a hole to close by deleting a flag.

lessons: This repository already converts prose into gates as a matter of course, and the idiom to copy is test-unit/delivery-contract.test.mjs: a node:test suite that READS package.json, the workflows and the hooks and fails when the teeth are removed. A new practice here is credible only if it lands with one of those, because `npm run test:unit` is inside check:ci and .husky/pre-push, which is the path master actually ships on.

An autopilot lane in this harness cannot write .claude/settings.json or .husky/*, so any recommendation whose fix is 'wire a hook' can only be delivered as a working script plus a verbatim paste block. Worth knowing before designing the fix, not after.

Before adding anything to check:ci here, check the ratchets it would move: scripts/agent-surface.mjs counts unmapped files under src/ only, so new scripts/ and test-unit/ files are free, but anything landing under src/ spends the 159-file baseline.

ADR-0007's rung discipline has a third failure mode this repo already names in its own hindsight section — green by exemption (scripts/actions-pin.mjs: STRICT = false, floor 0, prints '0 of N pinned' and passes). When a gap says 'the machinery exists and the policy does not', check for that shape before assuming nothing was built.
